# Load packages

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(fixest)
library(etwfe)
library(modelsummary)
library(kableExtra)
options("modelsummary_format_numeric_latex" = "plain")
```

# Load and prepare data

EU high-income comparison countries: AUT, BEL, DEU, DNK, FIN, FRA, IRL, ITA, LUX, NLD, SWE.
Non-EU high-income comparison countries: CAN, AUS, CHE, KOR, NZL.

```{r data}
library(rio)
ent <- rio::import("../unused_output/ESTparent_entry.rds")

# EU高所得国比較群（処置群GBRを含む）
EU_HI    <- c("AUT", "BEL", "DEU", "DNK", "FIN", "FRA",
              "IRL", "ITA", "LUX", "NLD", "SWE")

# 非EU高所得国比較群
NonEU_HI <- c("CAN", "AUS", "CHE", "KOR", "NZL")

# EU高所得国比較群のみ（GBR + EU_HI）
ent_EU <- ent %>%
  filter(iso %in% c("GBR", EU_HI))

cat("EU HI N rows:", nrow(ent_EU), "\n")
print(table(ent_EU$iso))

# EU高所得 + 非EU高所得の統合比較群（GBR + EU_HI + NonEU_HI）
ent_combined <- ent %>%
  filter(iso %in% c("GBR", EU_HI, NonEU_HI))

cat("\nCombined N rows:", nrow(ent_combined), "\n")
print(table(ent_combined$iso))
```

# EU HI Comparison: TWFE OLS Event Study

```{r twfe-ols-eu-est}
es_twfe_EU <- fixest::feols(
  entry ~ i(year, GBR, 2014) | year + pair_id,
  data = ent_EU,
  vcov = ~ iso
)
fixest::etable(es_twfe_EU)
```

```{r plot-twfe-ols-eu, dpi = 300}
ct_EU <- as.data.frame(fixest::coeftable(es_twfe_EU, vcov = ~ iso))
ct_EU$year  <- c(2010, 2012, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020)
ct_EU$lower <- ct_EU$Estimate - 1.96 * ct_EU$`Std. Error`
ct_EU$upper <- ct_EU$Estimate + 1.96 * ct_EU$`Std. Error`

ggplot(ct_EU, aes(x = year, y = Estimate, ymin = lower, ymax = upper)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2015.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Estimate, 3)), vjust = -0.5, hjust = 0.5, size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2010, 2012, 2014, 2016:2020)) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Coefficient (OLS)",
       title = "Effect of Brexit on Entry Probability (TWFE OLS)",
       caption = "TWFE OLS. Parent-country-year panel. EU high-income comparison countries.\nStandard errors clustered at country level. Reference year: 2014.") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# EU HI Comparison: ETWFE Logit Event Study

```{r etwfe-logit-eu-est}
es_etwfe_logit_EU <- etwfe::etwfe(
  entry ~ 1,
  tvar   = year,
  gvar   = first_year,
  data   = ent_EU,
  family = "logit",
  vcov   = ~ iso
)
fixest::etable(es_etwfe_logit_EU)

es_etwfe_logit_EU_me <- etwfe::emfx(es_etwfe_logit_EU, type = "event")
print(es_etwfe_logit_EU_me)
```

```{r plot-etwfe-logit-eu, dpi = 300}
es_etwfe_logit_EU_me$year <- es_etwfe_logit_EU_me$event + 2016

ggplot(es_etwfe_logit_EU_me, aes(x = year, y = estimate,
                                  ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 2015.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
  geom_pointrange() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(estimate, 3)), vjust = -0.5, hjust = 0.5, size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 2016:2020) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Average Marginal Effect (Logit)",
       title = "Effect of Brexit on Entry Probability (ETWFE Logit)",
       caption = "ETWFE Logit. Parent-country-year panel. EU high-income comparison countries.\nStandard errors clustered at country level.") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Estimation Table

```{r table-combined}
library(kableExtra)

# Helper: TWFE OLS coefficients → label/coef_fmt/se_fmt
fmt_twfe <- function(model) {
  ct <- as.data.frame(fixest::coeftable(model, vcov = ~ iso))
  ct$label <- c("UK $\\times$ 2010", "UK $\\times$ 2012",
                "UK $\\times$ 2016", "UK $\\times$ 2017",
                "UK $\\times$ 2018", "UK $\\times$ 2019",
                "UK $\\times$ 2020")
  ct$stars <- ifelse(ct$`Pr(>|t|)` < 0.001, "***",
               ifelse(ct$`Pr(>|t|)` < 0.01,  "**",
               ifelse(ct$`Pr(>|t|)` < 0.05,  "*", "")))
  ct$coef_fmt <- paste0(formatC(ct$Estimate,    digits = 3, format = "f"), ct$stars)
  ct$se_fmt   <- paste0("(", formatC(ct$`Std. Error`, digits = 3, format = "f"), ")")
  ct[, c("label", "coef_fmt", "se_fmt")]
}

# Helper: ETWFE Logit marginal effects → label/coef_fmt/se_fmt
fmt_logit <- function(me) {
  df <- as.data.frame(me)
  df$label <- c("UK $\\times$ 2016", "UK $\\times$ 2017",
                "UK $\\times$ 2018", "UK $\\times$ 2019",
                "UK $\\times$ 2020")
  df$stars <- ifelse(df$p.value < 0.001, "***",
               ifelse(df$p.value < 0.01,  "**",
               ifelse(df$p.value < 0.05,  "*", "")))
  df$coef_fmt <- paste0(formatC(df$estimate,   digits = 3, format = "f"), df$stars)
  df$se_fmt   <- paste0("(", formatC(df$std.error, digits = 3, format = "f"), ")")
  df[, c("label", "coef_fmt", "se_fmt")]
}

# Format all four models
d1 <- fmt_twfe(es_twfe_EU)
d2 <- fmt_logit(es_etwfe_logit_EU_me)
d3 <- fmt_twfe(es_twfe_comb)
d4 <- fmt_logit(es_etwfe_logit_comb_me)

# All coefficient labels
all_labels <- c("UK $\\times$ 2010", "UK $\\times$ 2012",
                "UK $\\times$ 2016", "UK $\\times$ 2017",
                "UK $\\times$ 2018", "UK $\\times$ 2019",
                "UK $\\times$ 2020")

get_val <- function(df, lbl, col) {
  idx <- which(df$label == lbl)
  if (length(idx) == 0) "" else df[[col]][idx]
}

# Interleave coef and SE rows
tab_long <- data.frame()
for (lbl in all_labels) {
  tab_long <- rbind(tab_long, data.frame(
    Term = lbl,
    C1   = get_val(d1, lbl, "coef_fmt"),
    C2   = get_val(d2, lbl, "coef_fmt"),
    C3   = get_val(d3, lbl, "coef_fmt"),
    C4   = get_val(d4, lbl, "coef_fmt"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  tab_long <- rbind(tab_long, data.frame(
    Term = "",
    C1   = get_val(d1, lbl, "se_fmt"),
    C2   = get_val(d2, lbl, "se_fmt"),
    C3   = get_val(d3, lbl, "se_fmt"),
    C4   = get_val(d4, lbl, "se_fmt"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
}

# GOF rows
fmt_n   <- function(m) formatC(as.numeric(m$nobs), format = "d", big.mark = ",")
fmt_r2  <- function(m) formatC(r2(m)["r2"],  digits = 3, format = "f")
fmt_pr2 <- function(m) formatC(r2(m)["pr2"], digits = 3, format = "f")

gof_rows <- data.frame(
  Term = c("Observations", "R-squared", "Pseudo R-squared",
           "Parent $\\times$ Country FE", "Group FE", "Year FE"),
  C1   = c(fmt_n(es_twfe_EU),             fmt_r2(es_twfe_EU),             "",                          "Yes", "No",  "Yes"),
  C2   = c(fmt_n(es_etwfe_logit_EU),      "",                             fmt_pr2(es_etwfe_logit_EU),  "No",  "Yes", "Yes"),
  C3   = c(fmt_n(es_twfe_comb),           fmt_r2(es_twfe_comb),           "",                          "Yes", "No",  "Yes"),
  C4   = c(fmt_n(es_etwfe_logit_comb),    "",                             fmt_pr2(es_etwfe_logit_comb),"No",  "Yes", "Yes"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
tab_long <- rbind(tab_long, gof_rows)

col_names <- c("", "(1) TWFE OLS", "(2) ETWFE Logit",
                   "(3) TWFE OLS", "(4) ETWFE Logit")

longnote <- "Columns (1)--(2): comparison group = EU high-income countries (AUT, BEL, DEU, DNK, FIN, FRA, IRL, ITA, LUX, NLD, SWE). Columns (3)--(4): comparison group = EU high-income plus CAN, AUS, CHE, KOR, NZL. The outcome is a binary indicator equal to one in the first year a Japanese parent company establishes an affiliate in a host country. Odd columns: OLS estimates from the TWFE event study model with parent-country pair and year fixed effects (reference year: 2014). Even columns: average marginal effects from the ETWFE logit model (Wooldridge, 2021). Standard errors clustered at the country level in parentheses. * p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001."

# HTML
kable(tab_long, col.names = col_names,
      caption = "Effect of Brexit on New Affiliate Entry Probability",
      align   = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c"), escape = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped") %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "EU HI" = 2, "EU HI + Non-EU HI" = 2)) %>%
  footnote(general = longnote, threeparttable = TRUE)

# LaTeX
kable(tab_long, col.names = col_names,
      caption = "Effect of Brexit on New Affiliate Entry Probability",
      label   = "entry_twfe",
      format  = "latex", booktabs = TRUE,
      align   = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c"), escape = FALSE) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position")) %>%
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "EU HI" = 2, "EU HI + Non-EU HI" = 2)) %>%
  footnote(general = longnote, threeparttable = TRUE,
           escape = FALSE, general_title = "\\\\textit{Notes:} ") %>%
  save_kable("../Tab/TableA_Entry_TWFE.tex")
```
